# Kydos Academy

Kydos Academy is operated by KYDOS DIGITAL LTD in Manchester, United Kingdom.

Primary website: https://academy.kydosdigital.com/
Programme: https://academy.kydosdigital.com/programme
Plan comparison: https://academy.kydosdigital.com/compare
Consultation: https://academy.kydosdigital.com/consultation
Guides: https://academy.kydosdigital.com/blog

## What Kydos Academy does

Kydos Academy teaches people how to build and operate their own independent UK digital marketing agency. It is not a franchise and not a white-label reselling scheme.

The programme covers company setup, finance foundations, brand, website, CRM, sales, recruitment, client onboarding, account management, creative delivery, quality control, reporting, acquisition, margin, capacity and operations.

## Programme routes

- Blueprint: £2,500
- Build With Us: £5,000
- Done For You: £10,000

Advertising spend, staff, software/provider charges and external professional fees are separate unless a written scope expressly includes them.

## Important limitations

Kydos Academy does not guarantee clients, revenue, a sponsor licence or a visa. Personal legal, tax, accounting and immigration advice should come from appropriately qualified or regulated professionals.
